map.解析布尔表达式并枚举全部 2ⁿ 种变量取值：变量 A–H，非 ! / ~，与 &: Parse a Boolean expression and enumerate all 2ⁿ assignments: variables A–H, NOT ! / ~, AND & / &&, OR | / ||, XOR ^, implication ->, equivalence <-> / ==, plus the AND / OR / NOT / XOR keywords; output every row and count true rows, classifying the expression as tautology, contradiction or satisfiable.

map.用法：输入布尔表达式（变量 A–H，支持 ! / & / | / ^ / ->: Enter a Boolean expression (variables A–H; supports ! / & / | / ^ / -> / <-> plus AND/OR/NOT/XOR and parentheses). The tool parses it by precedence, enumerates all 2ⁿ assignments, evaluates each row and counts true rows. n variables always give 2ⁿ rows.
map.例：A && (B || !C)，变量 A/B/C 共 8 行，结果为真的仅 3:
Example: A && (B || !C) with A/B/C gives 8 rows and only 3 true rows (A=1 with B=1, or A=1 with C=0), classified as satisfiable.
More: A || !A → both rows are 1, a tautology; A && !A → both rows are 0, a contradiction.
